conditional_bindings.source: Original initial frame + PSP restore. This condition does not prove loader is selected first after all registrations.

scope: Packaged M0 reset initialization, board selector, task creation and scheduler handoff. No physical hardware execution, full boot, authentication policy or SRAM remap/alias established.

gate.otherwise: Return cached unsigned byte at0x3fff70e8 with no sampling

board_selection.stability_assumption: Each bit is extracted from a distinct read; the simple combined index expression assumes synthetic or physical input remains stable across those reads.
board_selection.semantic_evidence: Literal source string at0x3fff4dc0 begins Board ver. Physical pins/register names remain unassigned.

ready_list.replacement_condition: When scheduler_running ==0, original requested priority >= current TCB+0x2c replaces current TCB; first TCB also becomes current.

subsequent_peer.note: Runs after loader registration via0x3ffefa22; equal-priority creation can replace current TCB. Later registrations also occur.

task_registration.limits: Heap results and critical helpers were stubbed in synthetic registration. No complete scheduler, task concurrency, interrupt timing or physical loader run was tested.

frequency_global.meaning: Constant also used by later SysTick divisor setup; no measured clock frequency

unknowns: No hardware documentation establishes the physical meaning of4dfff0xx or4dffb208 bit5 here.
This sequence does not establish SRAM alias/remap or an authentication decision.

decompiler_limitations: Nine genuine bounded angr10.0.5 C outputs are preserved unchanged; full Thumb is authoritative.
task_create_core raw C renders allocation failure as0xfffffffe; MOVS1/RSBS and original Thumb replay prove0xffffffff.
angr renders some DSB/CPS/MSR operations as unsupported; original full assembly and CPU emulation preserve those boundaries.
The prior0x3ffe36dc C is not repeated or included in new C count.
unknowns: No complete physical reset/boot execution or successful hardware initialization established.
No authentication policy or proof of absence of authentication follows from this bounded path.
Board-selected callees are identified by source table, but their full physical initialization is outside this pass.
